task.title: Build source connector framework
task.summary_zh: 把 source-ingest connector 抽成正式 framework：connector SDK、config schema、secret refs、auth、rate limit、license policy、source registry 與 provider examples。
acceptance: connector base interface supports auth secrets rate limits license and source metadata
static external feed and at least one provider example share the same contract
config validation rejects unsafe urls secrets and overlarge payloads
source registry exposes connector status and policy
BFF can read connector metadata through service client
